title: Volume Rebate Threshold and Rate for Corporate Travel Programmes
content:
Two figures carry the volume rebate on the Corporate Travel Programmes: the annual booking value at which a rebate begins to accrue, in USD, and the rebate on annual booking value above that threshold, as a percentage. Both are published per tier.

| Programme tier | Rebate threshold (USD of annual booking value) | Rebate rate above the threshold (per cent) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Business Starter Programme | 0.00 | 0.0 |
| Business Team Programme | 0.00 | 0.0 |
| Business Pro Programme | 250000.00 | 0.5 |
| Business Enterprise Programme | 1000000.00 | 1.0 |
| Business Enterprise Plus Programme | 4000000.00 | 1.5 |
| Business Global Programme | 12000000.00 | 2.25 |

The two lowest tiers publish a rebate rate of 0.0 per cent alongside a threshold of 0.00; on those tiers the published rate is nil whatever the annual booking value. Among the four tiers that publish a positive rate, the rate rises with the threshold rather than in place of it: the Business Global Programme's 2.25 per cent applies above a threshold of 12000000.00, while the Business Pro Programme's 0.5 per cent applies above 250000.00.
